scripts.name: Setup worktree
scripts.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun install --frozen-lockfile; else nix shell nixpkgs#bun -c bun install --frozen-lockfile; fi

scripts.name: Check
scripts.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run check; else nix shell nixpkgs#bun -c bun run check; fi

scripts.name: Dev
scripts.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run dev; else nix shell nixpkgs#bun -c bun run dev; fi

scripts.name: Sync dry run
scripts.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run sync -- --dry-run; else nix shell nixpkgs#bun -c bun run sync -- --dry-run; fi
